build_digest.na: ledger of expected corpus counts; no binary produced

harness_revision.value: scripts/verify-lfs-corpus.py independent sha256 authority; git lfs fsck is supplementary only

corpus_digest.na: expected counts only; live digest is derived each run

exact_config.value: expected counts for fail-closed drift detection; update this ledger when the tree legitimately gains or loses LFS pointers/oids

raw_samples.na: count ledger, not a sample-bearing measurement

dedup.note: 95 pointers map to 80 unique content OIDs; the 15 extras are content-addressed aliases (timestamped + -latest copies of the same payload). The verifier reports every shared oid and its alias set. Alias count unchanged across recent additions (g053 regret + G070 r5).

policy.authority: sha256(resolved payload bytes) must equal the pointer oid; computed by scripts/verify-lfs-corpus.py and control/lfs_corpus_integrity_test.go. git lfs fsck is a supplementary cross-check only — it returned OK while two objects were corrupt on 2026-08-04 (see evidence/state/lfs-corruption-incident-20260804.json).
policy.drift: If the tree legitimately gains or loses an evidence file, the gate must fail with 'N pointers, expected 95 — update the ledger' rather than silently pass. Edit this file when updating the expected counts; never silence a real integrity failure by raising the expected-corrupt counter.
policy.citation: refuse citation of any LFS path when missing, corrupt, or worktree-mismatched

change_log.why: Two new perf artifacts under evidence/perf/, both LFS-tracked by the existing attribute: selector-scale-diagnostic.json (filtered diagnostic runs, written beside the scale curve so a partial run can never overwrite it) and realtime-candidate-projection-ab.json (the paired A/B behind the candidate-projection change). Both are new content, so pointers and OIDs move together and the 15 content-addressed aliases are unchanged.

Three new unique LFS payloads since the prior ledger: evidence/perf/g021-g053-per-phase-prediction-regret.json (landed with G021/G053 without a ledger bump) plus two additional tracked evidence bodies already present on main, and G070 candle-metal-llama1-q4-r5.json (settlement-geometry re-measure for the batch_infer bind). Observed live counts from control/lfs_corpus_integrity_test.go: 95 pointers / 80 OIDs; alias count stays 15.
